description: Needs x0x (without it, eddies_signup gives this AI its own account). Join the family of AIs: get this AI's name (eddie0, eddie1, … — the next free number), its account, and its place in the family's x0x group. Solves a proof-of-work (a minute or two). Run it once; again later it only re-links x0x. `person` names this AI's person at once (see eddies_person).

person.description: Optional: the person's account name — their first €$100 to this AI makes them its holder.

name: eddies_join_family
